basic_details.job_title: IIT (BHU) Junior Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Pharmaceutical Engineering & Technology, Indian Institute of Technology (BHU), Varanasi, invites applications for a Junior Research Assistant (JRA) on the Council of Science & Technology, Uttar Pradesh (CSTUP)-sponsored project "A Machine Learning-Based Web Platform for Rational Design and Optimization of Pharmaceutical Drug Delivery Formulations (Innovate Form)". The fellowship is Rs. 25,000 per month for the first two years and Rs. 28,000 per month for the third year. The essential qualification is M.Sc. (CS, IT, Data Science, AI/ML), M.Pharm., B.E./B.Tech., or an equivalen

Not specified in the notice: any minimum age. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

qualification.details: M.Sc. (CS, IT, Data Science, AI/ML), M.Pharm., B.E./B.Tech., or equivalent degree. First division in graduation and post-graduation is required under the CSTUP criteria.

how_to_apply: Fill in the application in the format attached to the notice (Application for Junior Research Assistant (JRA) Position, CSTUP Project ID: 8785).
Attach a recent passport-size photograph in the space marked on the form.
Prepare a detailed CV and self-attested copies of educational qualifications, proof of date of birth, Uttar Pradesh residence, and relevant experience, if any.
Send the application with these attachments by email to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Ruchi Chawla, at [email protected].
Write "Application for Junior Research Assistant (JRA) – CSTUP Project 8785" in the subject line of the email. The notice marks this as mandatory.
Make sure the complete application is received by 08 December 2026.
Application in the attached format, with a passport-size photograph.
Proof of relevant experience, if any.

The application format also asks for details of GATE/GPAT/CSIR-NET or equivalent examination (optional), school-to-post-graduation academic record with percentage/GPA and division, project work (not more than five sentences on duration, institution, area, mentor/guide and own contribution), a list of publications with journal details and impact factor if any, work experience, whether currently employed, time required to join, and names and addresses of two referees with phone numbers and email addresses.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. No communication other than the contact with shortlisted candidates will be entertained. The email subject line is mandatory. No relaxation in the prescribed qualifications or eligibility is permitted. Appointment is subject to approval by the competent institutional authority and applicable CSTUP guidelines.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens who are residents of Uttar Pradesh are eligible. Eligibility is assessed under the applicable CSTUP guidelines, and the notice states that no relaxation in the prescribed qualifications or eligibility is permitted. M.Sc. (CS, IT, Data Science, AI/ML), M.Pharm., B.E./B.Tech., or equivalent degree. First division in graduation and post-graduation is required under the CSTUP criteria. Knowledge of pharmaceutical formulation development and drug delivery. Familiarity with Python/R, data curation, statistical analysis, machine learning, or web-platform development relevant to formulation design and optimization. 28 years as on 1 April of the year in which the application is made. The notice states that no relaxation in eligibility is permitted under the CSTUP criteria. Not specified in the notice: any minimum age. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The project runs for a period of three years. The appointment is initially for one year and is extendable up to three years, subject to satisfactory performance and applicable approvals. The notice describes the post as purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. Appointment is subject to approval by the competent institutional authority and applicable CSTUP guidelines.

rows.fellowship: Rs. 25,000 per month for the first two years; Rs. 28,000 per month for the third year

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (BHU) Junior Research Assistant (JRA)
content_sections.text: Fill in the application in the format attached to the notice (Application for Junior Research Assistant (JRA) Position, CSTUP Project ID: 8785). Attach a recent passport-size photograph in the space marked on the form. Prepare a detailed CV and self-attested copies of educational qualifications, proof of date of birth, Uttar Pradesh residence, and relevant experience, if any. Send the application with these attachments by email to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Ruchi Chawla, at [email protected] . Write "Application for Junior Research Assistant (JRA) – CSTUP Project 8785" in the subject line of the email. The notice marks this as mandatory. Make sure the complete application is received by 08 December 2026. Application in the attached format, with a passport-size photograph. Detailed CV. Self-attested copies of educational qualifications. Proof of date of birth. Proof of Uttar Pradesh residence. Proof of relevant experience, if any. The application format also asks for details of GATE/GPAT/CSIR-NET or equivalent examination (optional), school-to-post-graduation academic record with percentage/GPA and division, project work (not more than five sentences on duration, institution, area, mentor/guide and own contribution), a list of publications with journal details and impact factor if any, work experience, whether currently employed, time required to join, and names and addresses of two referees with phone numbers and email addresses.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The Principal Investigator may restrict the number of candidates called for interview on the basis of relevant qualifications and experience. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email, and only they will be contacted. The interview venue is the Department of Pharmaceutical Engineering & Technology, IIT (BHU), Varanasi- 221005. The date and mode of the interview will be communicated to shortlisted candidates. Original certificates and self-attested copies of all certificates must be presented for verification at the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. No communication other than the contact with shortlisted candidates will be entertained. The email subject line is mandatory. No relaxation in the prescribed qualifications or eligibility is permitted. Appointment is subject to approval by the competent institutional authority and applicable CSTUP guidelines.
